# React

One component, one job. Load data in the route or the event that asked for it. An effect that only fetches is the wrong layer.

A list key is a stable id when the list can reorder.

Do not silence the hooks dependency rule. Fix the dependency, or move the work to the event.

Hooks stay at the top level of the component.
